en: It looks like Kaito isn't here yet.
<CLT=cltMIND>Then, suddenly...

Hey, sorry I was late.
I had trouble bringing her.
Her?
Maki? Why is Maki here?
...That's what I'd like to know.

Someone kept buzzing my intercom and
I got so fed up, I finally opened the door.

Then this guy grabbed my arm and dragged
me all the way here—
Well, don't worry about the small stuff!

If we're gonna train, it's more fun with 
three people than two, right?

Training? The three of us? Is that really
the reason you dragged me here?
This is stupid... I'm going back.
Heh...you callin' this stupid?

Listen up! When a hero has to fight with a big
enemy, they train, train, then train some more!

That's what this training is! 
It's important for a hero like me.

So you guys can be like super dog, cat,
or horse by my side to help me be the hero!
Of all the examples you could have picked...

Did you really think that crazy explanation
would convince me to stay?
This is still stupid... I'm going back.

Hey, hold on a sec... When I said I was the
hero, that's just from my perspective.

Even super pets think of themselves
as heroes.

The same goes to both of you! Each of you
are the heroes of your own stories!
So act more like it!

I don't know what you're up to...but I told
you both to stay away from me.

You know this will end badly if you don't,
so why are you being so difficult?
How long are you going to run away?
...What?
<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito brought his face close to Maki's.

Your mask is coming down...
I could tell just by looking at you today.

So...you guys mind your business, I'll mind
mine, and we'll all agree to avoid each other.
Please...just pretend I'm not even here.

You're not the terrifying person the 
others think you are...
You're just a coward.
Hey, what's your enemy?
...Huh? My enemy?

You don't need to tell me what it is,
as long as you know it yourself.

So how long are you going to run away 
from your enemy?
...Run away?

Yeah, you've been running away.
It's pretty pathetic.

But...if you want to stand against it, 
even a little...

I'll train with you!
So you can be strong!
<CLT=cltMIND>...What?

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki is getting angry...
Kaito is just provoking her.

<CLT=cltMIND>Is he going to be okay?
He's antagonizing the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Assassin<CLT=cltMIND>...
So what are you going to do!?

Hey, Kaito...
It's okay, you don't have to—
...Fine, I'll do it.
Huh? You'll do it?

Don't get the wrong idea. He'll just bug me
about it later if I refuse.
Heh, so you do get it!

...The only way to deal with idiots like him
is to give up and just keep nodding.
Y-You don't get it at all!

Whatever...you just better get ready.
I won't hold back just cuz you're a girl.
...Well, what are we doing first?
Alright! First, 100 push-ups!

<CLT=cltMIND>Somehow, Maki ended up joining us and
the three of us trained together.
Hah...! Hah...! Hah...!

N-Not bad...Shuichi...
You're getting...better!

H-Hey Kaito...no slacking today, yeah?
I'm counting your reps!

Heh, I'm on fire today.
I can easily do 50 push-ups!
I thought we were doing a hundred!

Hey, what about you, Maki?
A hundred might be too hard for you, so-
Wha—!? That fast!?
100... I'm done.

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki stood and brushed the dirt from
her hands, totally composed.
Y-You're done already?

Y-You're not even out of breath...
I guess you've trained before, huh?

Aren't you breathing a little too hard?
It's not like we really pushed ourselves.

B-Before coming here, I did some warm ups...
I already did 500 push-ups, so...

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito...
*That* was the best lie you could come up with?

Anyway, I'm done and you can't say I didn't
train with you. I'm going back to my room.

Okay, we're doing training tomorrow, too!
You better be there!

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki ignored Kaito and left
without a word.
Geez, why's she gotta be so difficult?

Hey, Kaito...why did you do all this?
To help her?

Hm? If someone's weak, you help them out.
Teamwork's important for astronauts.

If someone's weak and suffering, 
there's no way you can just leave them!
Weak and suffering? *Maki*!?
Well, in that sense, you're—
No...your case is a little different.
What do you mean?

N-Nothing! Anyway, let's keep going. You're
still in the middle of your push-ups, right?
So are you.

Weren't you listening? I already did 
500 push-ups before I got here.
...Nice try, Kaito.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito ended up saying he "didn't remember"
how many push-ups he did...

<CLT=cltMIND>We agreed to just start over, and we were
exhausted by the time we reached 100.
